stx.text: Quintorius Kand arrives at Strixhaven after being expelled from Rundlestrom Military Academy for clumsiness, having agreed with the academy on one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.
Paired with the spirit mentor Asterion, whose statue he animates with the Rousing, Quint sneaks him past the dig at Pillardrop and recites the Canticle of Jed, which opens a shaft into a cave.
Below, they find Asterion's mummified body and the lost city of Zantafar spread out in eternal twilight.

In the Invocation of the Founders, Rootha is distracted by Nassari's arrival and Quint pours his own life into the spell to power it, and his planeswalker spark ignites, carrying him to another plane.

lci.text: Quintorius Kand planeswalks to Ixalan, where three dinosaurs corner him in the jungle until Wayta calls them off and leads him to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
There he meets Saheeli and Huatli, and when Huatli reads the tablets and fits them into the golden door, it cracks open.

Underground, Quint finds a fungus-covered stone city reminiscent of Zantafar and uses The Rousing on a poncho, summoning the ghost of an old man who cries that he must warn Oteclan of a mycoid infestation.
Quint later calls Abuelo back as an Echo, who recognizes Matzalantli and says they must warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant, and Quint and Abuelo restore Abuela as an Echo too.
